newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain shipyard fire kills at least 14.
newsitem.headline: Spain shipyard fire kills at least 14.

text.p: At least 14 people were killed on Thursday by a fire that engulfed a boat under construction in a Valencia shipyard, trapping workers inside, a port official said.
State television reported 16 were dead and at least 11 injured.
The port official said the fire was caused by a fuel leak on the boat which triggered an explosion just after midday (1000 GMT).
"There are more than 14 dead and an indeterminate number of injured," the official told Reuters.
The official said workers had been trapped inside the boat after the explosion at the Naval de Levante union shipyard in the east-cost port of Valencia.
Local media said the fire started in the engine room of the boat which was almost ready to sail.
Named "Proof Spirit", the boat was of Norwegian origin and was being built to carry a cargo of alcohol, local media said. It was approximately 130 metres long and 40 metres wide.
